body.statement: For any \(x\in\mathcal P_\delta(b,q,\omega)\) satisfying \(\rho_{10}(x,\omega)=\rho_{20}(x,\omega)>0\), and under \(\text{ass:reference-risk-positivity}\), the singleton value of \(\Psi_\omega(x)\) is below one if and only if \(\operatorname{VE}_1(x)>\operatorname{VE}_2(x)\), so biological vaccine effect wanes; it is above one if and only if \(\operatorname{VE}_1(x)<\operatorname{VE}_2(x)\), so biological vaccine effect strengthens.
body.justification: This calibration records the extra positive-placebo condition needed to interpret ratio direction biologically.
body.gap: The identity is positive-denominator algebra and is not claimed as a root contribution.
body.consumer: Booster-timing committees can separate a formally certified ratio statement from the extra condition required for a biological vaccine-effect interpretation.
